description: Neural or keyword web search with highlights, for agents. Up to 10 results, public URLs only. Returns { query, results: [{ title, url, publishedDate, score, highlights }] }: up to 10 results, each with up to 3 highlights of 500 characters. Price: 8 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

excludeDomains.description: Never return results from these domains (up to 20).

includeDomains.description: Only return results from these domains (up to 20).

startPublishedDate.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).

type.description: Search mode: auto (default), neural (semantic) or fast.

name: web-search
title: Web search
